title: PowerShell Security Monitoring
content: Monitor PowerShell execution logs for encoded commands, suspicious parent-child process relationships, and execution from unusual directories.

title: Brute Force Detection
content: Multiple failed authentication attempts from a single source within a short time window may indicate password spraying or brute-force activity.

title: Malware Incident Response
content: When malware is detected, isolate the affected host, preserve forensic evidence, identify persistence mechanisms, and perform threat hunting across the environment.

title: DNS Tunneling Detection
content: Indicators of DNS tunneling include unusually long domain names, high query volume, high entropy subdomains, and communication with suspicious domains.

title: Phishing Incident Triage
content: Analyze email headers, sandbox attachments, detonate suspicious URLs, and purge malicious messages from internal mailboxes.

title: Ransomware Remediation
content: Sever network connectivity, preserve memory captures, verify backup integrity, and do not reboot affected servers.

title: VLAN Hopping Defense
content: Disable DTP on all switch ports, place unused ports into a blackhole VLAN, and configure explicit access or trunk modes.

title: SQL Injection Defense
content: Ensure all web applications utilize parameterized queries or prepared statements, and enforce input validation via Web Application Firewalls.

title: Cross-Site Scripting Mitigation
content: Implement strict Content Security Policy headers and ensure all user-supplied data is properly HTML entity encoded.

title: Physical Security Access Control
content: Audit badge reader logs for velocity alerts, disable access for terminated employees, and integrate camera feeds with ACS alerts.

title: SSH Key Management
content: Prohibit password-based SSH authentication, mandate Ed25519 key pairs, and rotate keys dynamically via a centralized secrets manager.

title: WMI Abuse Detection
content: Monitor the Windows-WMI-Activity operational log for suspicious remote process creation via the Win32_Process class.

title: Rogue Access Point Hunting
content: Perform routine wireless sweeps utilizing WIDS/WIPS sensors to detect unauthorized SSIDs operating on corporate frequencies.

title: Data Exfiltration Detection
content: Baseline normal outbound data transfer volumes per user and alert on sudden large spikes over HTTPS, FTP, or DNS protocols.

title: Printer Security Hardening
content: Change all default administrator passwords on network printers, disable unnecessary protocols, and place on isolated VLANs.

title: Scheduled Task Auditing
content: Review Windows Event ID 4698 for new scheduled task creation and flag executions originating from user profile directories.

title: SIEM Log Integrity
content: Forward all SIEM audit logs to an immutable storage bucket and configure alerting for audit log clearance events.

title: VPN Gateway Hardening
content: Enforce certificate-based authentication alongside RADIUS MFA for all remote access VPN connections and disable split-tunneling.

title: Database Auditing Configuration
content: Enable Database Unified Auditing to capture statements on sensitive tables and monitor for unexpected bulk data extraction.

title: Jump Server Architecture
content: Require RDP access to critical infrastructure to originate exclusively from hardened jump servers with session recording enabled.

title: Macro Security Policy
content: Configure Office Group Policy to block macros executing from files originating from the internet.

title: Shadow IT Discovery
content: Analyze proxy and firewall egress logs to identify unauthorized cloud storage or SaaS application usage.

title: Email Forwarding Rule Monitoring
content: Audit message tracking logs for anomalous Inbox rules forwarding internal communications to external domains.

title: C2 Beacon Analysis
content: Perform frequency analysis on proxy logs to identify uniform HTTPS requests indicative of automated Command and Control beaconing.

title: Executive Protection Monitoring
content: Enroll C-suite accounts in dedicated dark web monitoring and enforce aggressive lockout policies on AD credentials.

title: Legal Data Classification
content: Apply mandatory sensitivity labels to all documents residing on legal department file shares.

title: Proxy SSL Decryption
content: Deploy internal root CA certificates via GPO to all managed endpoints to facilitate transparent SSL inspection.

title: Camera Network Isolation
content: Ensure IP cameras are segmented on a non-routable VLAN with zero internet egress to prevent botnet hijacking.

title: Vulnerability Scanner Tuning
content: Configure authenticated vulnerability scans to run during off-peak hours and exclude fragile legacy assets.

title: Backup Environment Hardening
content: Store primary backup repositories on dedicated storage arrays with air-gapped immutable copies in a secondary datacenter.

title: Antivirus Evasion Detection
content: Alert on registry modifications targeting AV policies indicating intent to disable security controls.

title: GitHub Secrets Scanning
content: Integrate pre-commit hooks and automated repository scanning to prevent developers from publishing hardcoded credentials.

title: DevOps Container Registries
content: Enforce image signing and vulnerability scanning on all base images before deployment to production.

title: QA Environment Data Sanitization
content: Implement automated data masking scripts to obfuscate PII before migrating production database dumps to QA servers.

title: RDP Tunneling Detection
content: Monitor network traffic flows for unexpected application protocols tunneling over standard TCP 3389 connections.

title: Administrator Account Auditing
content: Review Active Directory for unexpected user creation and assignment to local or domain admin groups.

title: Port Scan Triage
content: Correlate inbound TCP sweeps with subsequent exploitation attempts in IPS logs to differentiate background noise.

title: Spooler Service Abuse
content: Disable the Print Spooler service on all domain controllers and critical servers not required to function as print servers.

title: Cryptomining Incident Containment
content: Terminate processes matching known miner signatures, isolate the endpoint, and block mining pool IPs.

title: USB Mass Storage Restrictions
content: Deploy endpoint DLP policies to block unauthorized USB mass storage devices and enforce encryption.

title: BGP Route Hijack Mitigation
content: Implement RPKI route validation and configure strict prefix filtering on all external facing BGP peerings.

title: Container Security Best Practices
content: Enforce read-only root filesystems, drop unnecessary Linux capabilities, and prevent privileged container execution.

title: AWS IAM Least Privilege
content: Regularly audit AWS IAM roles, remove wildcard permissions, and mandate MFA for all console access.

title: LSASS Dumping Prevention
content: Enable Credential Guard and monitor for untrusted processes requesting memory read permissions against lsass.exe.

title: Active Directory Tiering
content: Implement the tier model to restrict domain administrators from logging into standard user workstations.

title: Kerberoasting Detection
content: Monitor for anomalous service ticket requests matching SPN configurations with weak encryption algorithms.

title: AS-REP Roasting Prevention
content: Ensure 'Do not require Kerberos preauthentication' is disabled for all user accounts in Active Directory.

title: NTLMv1 Disablement
content: Disable NTLMv1 authentication globally via Group Policy to prevent hash cracking and relay attacks.

title: SMB Signing Enforcement
content: Require SMB signing on all workstations and servers to mitigate internal man-in-the-middle attacks.

title: LDAP Signing Required
content: Configure domain controllers to reject simple LDAP binds and require secure LDAP configurations.

title: Zero Trust Network Access
content: Migrate from traditional VPNs to application-specific micro-tunnels verifying device posture continuously.

title: Third-Party Risk Management
content: Require annual SOC 2 Type II reports and automated security posture scoring for all SaaS vendors.

title: Endpoint Detection and Response
content: Ensure EDR agents are deployed, communicating, and updating properly across the entire endpoint fleet.

title: Mobile Device Management
content: Require conditional access policies ensuring mobile devices are encrypted and not jailbroken before syncing corporate email.

title: Cloud Security Posture Management
content: Utilize automated tools to identify publicly accessible storage buckets and overly permissive security groups.

title: Web Application Firewall Tuning
content: Review WAF block logs weekly to adjust custom rule sets and reduce false positive block rates.

title: DDoS Mitigation Activation
content: Configure automatic BGP traffic scrubbing thresholds to activate when inbound bandwidth exceeds 10Gbps.

title: Threat Intelligence Integration
content: Automate the ingestion of STIX/TAXII feeds into the SIEM for real-time indicator correlation.

title: Incident Response Tabletop
content: Conduct quarterly simulated exercises involving IT, legal, and executive teams to refine the IR playbook.

title: Forensic Image Acquisition
content: Utilize write-blockers and generate cryptographic hashes when capturing physical drives for legal hold.

title: Memory Analysis Baseline
content: Perform Volatility analysis on compromised hosts to identify injected threads and hidden rootkit drivers.

title: Log Retention Policy
content: Maintain 90 days of hot SIEM storage and 1 year of cold archive storage for compliance auditing.

title: Patch Management SLA
content: Deploy critical security updates within 7 days of release and standard functional updates within 30 days.

title: Out-of-Band Management
content: Isolate iDRAC, iLO, and IPMI interfaces on dedicated physical management switches disconnected from the production LAN.

title: Network Time Protocol Security
content: Synchronize all infrastructure to internal stratum servers utilizing NTP authentication keys to prevent time tampering.

title: Syslog Forwarding Reliability
content: Configure network devices to forward logs via TCP rather than UDP to guarantee delivery during congestion.

title: DNS Sinkholing Strategy
content: Redirect known malicious domain queries to an internal sinkhole server to identify infected endpoints.

title: Privileged Access Management
content: Mandate the use of a password vault requiring approval workflows for check-out of critical infrastructure credentials.

title: Certificate Lifecycle Management
content: Deploy automated agents to alert on impending SSL/TLS certificate expirations 30 days prior to invalidation.

title: File Integrity Monitoring
content: Alert on unauthorized modifications to critical system files in /etc/ and system32 directories.

title: Data Loss Prevention Alerts
content: Investigate alerts generated by credit card or social security number regex patterns traversing email gateways.

title: Software Bill of Materials
content: Require an SBOM for all internally developed applications to track vulnerable open-source dependencies.

title: API Gateway Rate Limiting
content: Enforce strict IP-based rate limiting on external APIs to prevent automated enumeration and scraping.

title: Serverless Function Security
content: Assign minimal execution roles to cloud functions and scan deployment packages for hardcoded secrets.

title: Database Encryption at Rest
content: Enable Transparent Data Encryption on all production database clusters utilizing external key management systems.

title: Red Team Engagement
content: Schedule annual objective-based red team assessments to evaluate detection and response capabilities.

title: Bug Bounty Triage
content: Acknowledge submitted vulnerability reports within 48 hours and coordinate remediation based on CVSS scoring.

title: Social Engineering Awareness
content: Conduct monthly simulated phishing campaigns and enroll repeat clickers in mandatory remedial training.

title: Clean Desk Policy
content: Ensure physical documents containing sensitive information are locked away when workstations are unattended.

title: Tailgating Prevention
content: Require all personnel to swipe individual badges at turnstiles and challenge unknown individuals lacking visible credentials.

title: Visitor Management System
content: Log all physical guests, issue temporary expiring badges, and require escort by full-time employees.

title: Hardware Asset Inventory
content: Perform quarterly physical reconciliation of datacenter hardware against the Configuration Management Database.

title: Software License Auditing
content: Review deployed commercial software agents against active license counts to prevent vendor compliance violations.

title: End of Life System Hardening
content: Isolate legacy operating systems that can no longer receive security patches on restricted enclave networks.

title: Wire Transfer Verification
content: Implement out-of-band voice verification for all executive requests initiating external financial transactions.

title: Vendor Remote Access
content: Restrict external support vendors to time-limited VPN sessions utilizing just-in-time account provisioning.

title: Logon Workstation Restrictions
content: Configure Active Directory to restrict service accounts so they can only authenticate from their designated host servers.

title: Guest Wi-Fi Isolation
content: Ensure wireless guest networks route directly to the internet ISP connection with no internal routing paths.

title: IoT Device Segmentation
content: Place smart TVs, thermostats, and appliances on dedicated VLANs isolated from corporate endpoint networks.

title: Mainframe Access Control
content: Require strict RACF security configurations and monitor TN3270 emulation sessions for abnormal transaction volumes.

title: Source Code Repository Auditing
content: Restrict master branch direct commits and require two peer reviews before merging pull requests.

title: CI/CD Pipeline Security
content: Run static application security testing (SAST) during automated build pipelines to break builds containing critical flaws.

title: Dynamic Application Security Testing
content: Schedule weekly DAST scans against staging web application environments to identify runtime vulnerabilities.

title: Session Token Invalidation
content: Ensure web application authentication tokens expire after 15 minutes of inactivity and upon absolute logout.

title: Password Complexity Policy
content: Enforce a minimum 14-character length for domain passwords and cross-reference against known breached password dictionaries.

title: Local Admin Password Solution
content: Deploy LAPS to randomize and manage local administrator account passwords uniquely across all domain-joined endpoints.

title: Sysmon Deployment Strategy
content: Install Sysinternals Sysmon globally to capture detailed process creation, network connections, and file creation events.

title: Windows Event Forwarding
content: Utilize native WEF subscriptions to centrally collect high-value security events without requiring third-party agents.

title: Honeypot Deployment
content: Deploy internal decoy servers broadcasting vulnerable services to detect lateral movement and reconnaissance scanning.

title: Canary Token Tracking
content: Embed traceable URLs and document beacons in fictitious internal files to identify unauthorized exfiltration.
